anna: quick question — I'm double-checking the API contract for /v1/infer when both a model_pin and model_hint (or region/tier hints) are present. Is the response's served_model envelope going to add a new nested metadata field?

mike: short answer: we planned a small v2 addition to served_model.metadata for GPU/memory info, but we need to be careful not to break clients that introspect served_model as a string.

sasha: can you paste the example payload you have in mind? iirc old shape is just { served_model: "rw-large-v1" } which a few SDKs treat as opaque.

anna: here's what product asked for (proposal):
```json
{
  "model_pin": null,
  "model_hint": "rw-large-v2",
  "region_hint": "eu-west-1",
  "tier": "standard"
}
```
and response example they want:
```json
{
  "id": "req_123",
  "output": "...",
  "served_model": {
    "id": "rw-large-v2-q4-32k",
    "variant": "q4_0",
    "metadata": { "gpu": "a100", "quant": "q4_0" }
  }
}
```

priya: that response is richer but could break code that does `response.served_model.startsWith(...)`. we should either keep served_model as string for backward compat and add served_model_details, OR document that served_model becomes an object in v2 and add a content-negotiation header.

mike: agreed — two safe options:
- keep served_model (string) + add served_model_details (object) OR
- switch to object but support the old string key for N-1 clients for 6 weeks.

anna: preference from product is to avoid duplicate fields. they want a single canonical field. but engineering prefers additive changes.

infra-bot: deploy-canary plan: canary to 5% region eu-west-1, eu-central for 48h, fallback to legacy shape on errors > 1% or error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute.

sasha: any SDKs that will fail hard? i know the JS client maps served_model -> string in types. need a soft landing.

mike: i'll add a compatibility shim in the JS/py SDKs: if served_model is object, map to served_model.id for existing fields. will add tests.

priya: also consider header negotiation: clients can set `Accept-ServeModel: v2` to opt-in. makes migration explicit.

anna: timeline ask: product wants this in the next minor release (2 weeks). can we do a patch: keep string field + add details with deprecation note if that buys time?

mike: yes i'll put up a PR today with the dual-field approach + tests + SDK shim. will call out deprecation schedule in the API changelog.

sasha: i'll review CR. quick ask: what should router do when model_pin conflicts with model_hint region? e.g., pin is global but hint region=europe.

mike: router priority: model_pin > region_pin > model_hint > region_hint > tier. if pin has region-scoped placement that doesn't match hint, we ignore hint and return pinned model placement. will add to spec.

anna: perfect. can someone update the public API doc and the compatibility section? tagging @mike for CR, @sasha for docs review.

mike: on it — PR shortly.

priya: i'll open a short support note template so CS has a response if customers ask about the served_model shape.

anna: thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: note: logging change required — add served_model.id to token-level cost logs to help debugging during canary.

mike: ack, will include logging change in PR.

sasha: CR ping when ready, i'll do docs + release-notes edit after merge.

anna: done for now, will follow up if product changes mind.
